name: provider-error
description: A query the grammar rejects: 400 naming the offending operator and field. Vendor non-2xx is DATA — zero usage, body relayed verbatim (the message is the actionable part, so it must reach the caller). Recorded live 2026-09-16 by applying is_similar_to to a field that does not support it.

body.query: select from companies where estimated_employee_count >= 500 and industry is_similar_to ("Software Development")

body.message: 'is_similar_to' is not supported on field 'industry'. It can only be used on job title fields or the company products_and_services field.
